title: Education Expanded Upward While Classrooms Thinned
hook: More students reached higher levels while pupil pressure eased below.
closing: Education expanded at every level without simply packing more pupils behind each teacher.
question: Which education change matters most?

segments.say: Secondary enrollment reached 77.3 percent. Education access nearly doubled from the earlier baseline.
Women reached 43.9 percent of tertiary academic staff. Education expansion also changed who teaches at the top.
Adult female literacy reached 84.6 percent. Education gains now extend beyond classrooms into lifelong basic skills.
The primary pupil-teacher ratio fell to 23.4. Education expansion did not require classrooms to grow more crowded.
